      Request for Official Real-Time Market Data API for Albion Online

      May 22nd 2024

      Hello,

      As an active player and passionate developer, I am writing to inquire about the availability of an official API for real-time market data in Albion Online.

      I am aware of the existence of a community-driven API that is regularly updated by the community. However, using this API sometimes has its limitations due to the update frequency, which does not always allow for real-time data retrieval.

      To enhance my projects and provide a more enriching experience for the Albion Online community, I would like to know if there is an official API offered by SandBox Interactive that would allow access to real-time market data while complying with the game's terms of service. If this option is not currently available, is there a possibility that it could be implemented in the near future?

      I am open to discussions to explore various possibilities that could benefit the Albion Online community.

      Thank you in advance for your response and for the time you will spend addressing my request.

      Best regards,

      • Quote
      • Go to Page Top

    • Nesnes

      Community Manager

      Likes Received
      1,330
      Posts
      786
      • 2

      May 22nd 2024

      Hi!

      The request for an API has been around for some time, and it is generally something we think about doing, but so far it isn't happening yet.

      There are lots of reasons for that, the main one being that we don't have our systems set up in a way that it would be sensible, and doing that would take a lot of time, which we haven't been able to make in the development cycle yet.

      So it is something we are considering, just not something we can do quickly.

      But thank you for bringing it up, and for now I will poke the devs again to see what the status is
